positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerified
positions.frame: what is the verified calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph, and against what reference was it checked?
positions.why: All three expressions read in one direction: a settled, present-tense claim that the named instrument's calibration (88.4 MHz) has been checked against the June reference plates and holds. src-1 states the claim in prose; src-2 and src-3 restate the same instrument/calibration facts as structured field labels. The register and temporal reads across all three are uniform (flat technical delivery, present/realis/concrete), and conviction sits at claim-level for each — none rises to a ratifying decision, but all three assert the same verified state rather than merely gesturing at it. No tension: the group is coherent, not contested.
